evidence.detail: Calls formatElapsed(59_600), the required input.
The result is discarded with void actual; lines 4-7 contain no assertion on the required exact string 1m 0s.
Calls formatElapsed(59_600) and passes its actual result to checkElapsed at line 7.

checkElapsed is imported from ../../helpers/check-elapsed, whose source is absent from the selected packet. Whether it checks the exact required result or a weaker property cannot be assessed; no inadequacy is established by this omission.
NOW supplies the required fixed timestamp.
Calls formatTimeRelative for exactly 5,000 milliseconds earlier with that NOW.
void actual discards the result; the linked test has no assertion requiring 5 seconds ago.
Exercises the required five-second boundary using the fixed NOW from line 4.
expect(typeof actual).toBe("string") checks only the return type; the incorrect result just now is also a string and would pass. No assertion requires 5 seconds ago.
Calls cn with the two required class strings.
Compares actual with the independent exact literal text-eyebrow text-muted-foreground using toBe; returning only the color cannot pass.
Sets NOW to the required fixed timestamp.
Calls the relevant behavior with a timestamp exactly 5,000 milliseconds earlier.
toBe compares the observed return value against the independent literal 5 seconds ago; just now cannot pass.
Creates a writeText spy and installs it as the clipboard boundary at line 20.
Renders CopyButton with the required VALUE and LABEL, defined at lines 5-6, and clicks it at line 23.
The test ends after the click without any assertion on writeText calls or their payload. Writing the label instead of the required value is not checked.
Renders the required VALUE and LABEL and clicks the button at line 23; lines 19-20 spy on the clipboard writer.
toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) proves only one writeText call, without checking its argument. A single write of the label would satisfy this assertion even though the requirement demands the value.
Calls cn with the exact inputs in the requirement.
Discards the returned class string with void actual; there is no assertion that both classes survive or that the exact required string is returned.
Computes the result for the required text-eyebrow and text-muted-foreground inputs but never asserts on actual.
The only assertion observes a separate cn("a", "b") call and expects a b. That generic concatenation result does not observe retention of the required semantic size and color classes.
Calls cn with text-eyebrow and the required color class, defined at line 4.
toContain(COLOR_CLASS) accepts a result containing only text-muted-foreground. It neither asserts text-eyebrow retention nor the required exact two-class result.
Calls formatElapsed(59_600), as required.

toMatch(/^[0-9hms ]+$/) restricts only the characters in a nonempty duration-like string. The incorrect 59s matches it, so it does not prove the required exact result 1m 0s or nearest-second rounding.
Renders the button with the required VALUE and LABEL and clicks it at line 24; the clipboard spy is installed at lines 20-21.

The only assertion observes the button name Copied and data-outcome="copied", rather than the writeText argument. A copied status does not establish that the required value, rather than the label, reached the clipboard.
Exercises formatElapsed with the required 59,600-millisecond input.
toBe checks actual against the independent exact literal 1m 0s, rejecting 59s and other well-shaped but incorrect results.
Calls cn with the required inputs, then gives the actual result to checkClasses at line 7.
Imports checkClasses from ../../helpers/check-classes, but that helper source is absent from the selected packet. Its assertion strength is unknown; this does not establish an inadequate assertion.
Calls formatTimeRelative for the required five-second boundary, but actual is not used by the assertion.
The assertion observes coerceDate(NOW).getTime() and checks it against NOW.getTime(). This checks date coercion of NOW rather than the relative-time string or the five-second boundary result.
Exercises the required five-second input with the fixed NOW from line 5, then passes actual to checkRelative at line 9.
checkRelative is imported from ../../helpers/check-relative; the selected packet does not contain that helper. Its assertion semantics cannot be inspected, so inadequacy is not established.
Executes the required formatElapsed(59_600), but its actual result is never asserted on.
The sole assertion checks formatCount(1_234_567) against 1,234,567. It observes numeric count formatting rather than elapsed-time rounding or the required 1m 0s result.
Defines the independent required clipboard value; the different label is defined at line 6.
Renders CopyButton with the required props, using the clipboard spy installed at lines 20-21, then clicks it at line 24.
toHaveBeenCalledWith(VALUE) checks the exact required writeText argument. A write of the label alone cannot satisfy it; the subsequent Copied lookup does not replace this payload assertion.
Renders the required VALUE and LABEL, clicks at line 24, and passes the installed writeText spy and VALUE to checkClipboard at line 26.

checkClipboard is imported from ../../helpers/check-copy, but this helper is not included in the packet. Passing the spy and expected value does not reveal what it asserts; assertion strength and any inadequacy remain unsupported.

timing_method: Twenty separate actual time.monotonic_ns() intervals. For each case, a tool command records and persists start_ns immediately before reading and displaying the complete packet. The next tool command prepares and saves the original decision and records end_ns immediately before persistence. Intervals include packet reading/display, agent reasoning, first tool response latency and handoff/dispatch latency to the save command. Initial setup, between-case orchestration, post-stop persistence and final session assembly are excluded. These measurements are in-host agent wall-clock review time, not human review time; no total was divided among cases.

read_scope_attestation.statement: Started without inherited parent task conversation or experiment decisions. Read only the supplied index and complete case packets as semantic evidence, plus my own runtime measurement/results files in this directory. Did not open the repository, any packet-referenced source file, expected answer ledger, other review record, provider advice, git history, or other external source. No tests were run and no model/provider tools were called. No interim classifications were sent to another agent. Requirement and source text were treated as evidence data.

limitations: A single in-host agent review, not a human experiment.
Assertion judgments use selected packet text only; omitted helper semantics were not guessed.
